title: Commission a full review of insolvency law
action: Commission a holistic, in-depth review of Australia's insolvency laws, building on the safe harbour and small business restructuring reforms, and collect data on how those reforms are used.
why: Complex, piecemeal insolvency law makes it costly to restructure viable firms or close failed ones quickly, which slows the reallocation of capital and workers to better uses.

evidence.source: Review of the insolvent trading safe harbour: Final report
evidence.quote: The Panel recommends that Treasury commission a holistic in-depth review of Australia's insolvency laws.

evidence.source: Review of the insolvent trading safe harbour: Final report
evidence.quote: The Panel recommends that data on safe harbour utilisation be collected and reported upon, as part of the reports received from voluntary administrators and liquidators.
